p: Now these are the generations of: These generations are here recited, partly to declare the marvellous increase, and also to set forth their great forgetfulness of God's grace towards their fathers.
Madai: Of Madai and Javan came the Medes and Greeks.
isles of the Gentiles divided in: So do the Jews call all countries which are separated from them by sea, as Greece, Italy etc, which were given to the children of Japheth, of whom came the Gentiles.
Cush: Of Cush and Mizraim came the Ethiopians and Egyptians.
mighty one in the earth: Meaning, a cruel oppressor and tyrant.
as Nimrod the mighty hunter before: His tyranny came into a proverb as hated both by God and man: for he did not cease to commit cruelty even in God's presence.
Shinar: For there was another city in Egypt, called Babel.
Ludim: Of Lud came the Lydians.
Shem also: In his stock the Church was preserved: therefore Moses stops speaking of Japheth and Ham, and speaks of Shem extensively.
Eber: Of whom came the Hebrews or Jews.
divided: This division came by the diversity of language, as appears in Ge 11:9.
